roles.name: Data Sponsor
roles.purpose: Executive who funds the governance programme and owns its outcomes at board level.
responsibilities: Secure budget and people for the governance programme.
Set data priorities aligned with company strategy.
Chair escalations the Governance Council cannot resolve.
decisions: Approve the governance charter and yearly roadmap.
Resolve cross-domain conflicts escalated by the Council.

roles.name: Governance Council
roles.purpose: Cross-domain body that sets policies and standards and arbitrates between domains.
responsibilities: Approve enterprise policies (classification, access, retention, change management).
Approve glossary terms shared by more than one domain.
Review quality and maturity metrics every month.
Approve the retirement of datasets with downstream consumers.

roles.name: Data Owner
roles.purpose: Business leader accountable for the data of one domain and the decisions about it.
responsibilities: Be accountable for the quality, classification and use of the domain's data.
Approve access to confidential and restricted data of the domain.
Approve breaking changes to the domain's data contracts.
Appoint at least one Data Steward for the domain.
decisions: Grant or deny access to the domain's data.
Accept or reject quality rules and their thresholds.

roles.name: Data Steward
roles.purpose: Subject-matter expert who manages the domain's data day to day.
responsibilities: Draft and maintain glossary terms and data contracts.
Define quality rules and triage quality incidents and quarantined rows.
Approve access to internal data of the domain.
Keep documentation current and run periodic reviews.
decisions: Accept a glossary definition for review by the Owner.
Decide how a quality incident is remediated at source.

roles.name: Data Custodian
roles.purpose: Technical role that operates the platform where data is stored, moved and secured.
responsibilities: Run and monitor pipelines; implement contracts and quality rules in code.
Implement access grants and masking exactly as the policy states.
Manage backups, retention and decommissioning of datasets.
decisions: Choose technical implementation within the agreed contract and policy.

roles.name: Data Consumer
roles.purpose: Analyst or application that uses published data for decisions.
responsibilities: Use data according to its classification and contract.
Report suspected quality issues through the incident process.
Request access through the access workflow, never ad hoc.
decisions: None on the data itself; decides how to use data within policy.

roles.name: Field Technician
roles.purpose: Uses operational data to plan and carry out field work; has no need for financial or personal data.
responsibilities: Use asset, order and labor data of the assigned domain to plan and execute work.
Report data that looks wrong in the field through the quality incident process.
decisions: None on the data itself; decides how to schedule and execute work within policy.

roles.name: Data Auditor
roles.purpose: Independent reviewer who checks that governance controls exist and work, in read-only mode.
responsibilities: Review access grants, segregation of duties and exception expiry.
Review quality evidence, quarantine handling and the decision log.
Report audit findings to the Governance Council.
decisions: Raise audit findings and request evidence; never changes data or grants.

raci.name: Define a glossary term
raci.description: Draft the definition, formula, source and rules of a business term.

raci.name: Approve a glossary term
raci.description: Move a term from draft to approved; shared terms go to the Council.

raci.name: Approve a quality rule
raci.description: Accept a new or changed rule and its severity in a data contract.

raci.name: Resolve a quality incident
raci.description: Triage quarantined rows or failed checks, fix at source and close the incident.

raci.name: Approve an access request
raci.description: Grant time-bound access above a user's role baseline. Requester can never approve.

raci.name: Change a data contract
raci.description: Version a contract. Breaking changes need a major version and Owner approval.

raci.name: Retire a dataset
raci.description: Deprecate, notify consumers, wait the notice period and decommission.

raci.name: Classify a dataset
raci.description: Assign public, internal, confidential or restricted and the PII tags.

raci.name: Approve a governance policy
raci.description: Adopt or change an enterprise data policy or standard.

domains.name: Field operations
domains.description: Assets, field technicians, service orders and hours booked against them.

domains.name: Supply chain
domains.description: Material master, warehouse issues to service orders and inventory position.

domains.name: Customer
domains.description: Customer accounts, business contacts and customer value.
